note.completionDefinition: reader-visible official paid note page verified with title, price, paid boundary and dedicated cover image
note.catchUpPriority: current-day five-item materialized batch before legacy blockers

operationalState.pcAssumption: After 01:00 JST do not assume the Windows publisher is online. When it is available, remaining current-day publication recovery is the first priority.
operationalState.strictPublicationState: 5/5 reader-visible verified; canonical publication receipts exist for all five required IDs
operationalState.fallbackPolicy: Paid NOTE floor is satisfied. Continue current-day BOOTH and designated free NOTE recovery before legacy blockers or unrelated new production.
operationalState.debtRule: Only reader-visible verification of URL, exact title, expected price, paid boundary and dedicated cover decrements paid debt or counts toward the paid daily target.

freeAcquisitionExperiment.strictFreePublicationDefinition: reader-visible official note page verified with exact title, free state and dedicated cover image
freeAcquisitionExperiment.adaptationRule: The two designated 2026-08-23 free NOTE entries remain required by completion_gate and should publish after paid NOTE, without replacing BOOTH debt.
freeAcquisitionExperiment.separationRule: Free publications never decrement paid publication debt and never replace the paid 5/day strict floor.

BOOTH.completionDefinition: buyer-visible official BOOTH product page verified with title, price, downloadable-product state and purchase path
BOOTH.catchUpPriority: complete current-day genuine-new paid batch before deferred legacy blockers

operationalState.pcAssumption: After 01:00 JST do not assume the Windows publisher is online. When it is available, current-day BOOTH recovery is now the highest paid priority.
operationalState.materializationState: complete: five encrypted payload ZIPs passed cloud QA with product.json, product.zip, preview01.jpg and SHA recorded in queue index
operationalState.fallbackPolicy: Process all five genuine-new current-day items. One strict success is not a stopping condition. After a brief recoverable failure, preserve the item as retryable, switch to another current-day item, then return later. Do not route to 009 while current-day quota remains.
operationalState.debtRule: Only explicit verification of all required buyer checks on a newly published item decrements debt.

rules: Paid daily targets are hard minimums and must not be silently reduced for expected-profit optimization.
For 2026-08-23, paid NOTE is strict verified 5/5; BOOTH 5/5 and the designated free NOTE 2/2 remain required before completion.
A paid scheduled slot that cannot reach verified publication is not discarded; it becomes paid publication debt.
Paid publication debt survives date changes and PC power-off periods until buyer/reader-visible publication is verified.
One run may complete multiple publications when debt exists or today's floor remains; pacing preferences are not production caps.

Do not count queue insertion, local publisher success logs without strict verification, editor/admin URLs, drafts, commits, old-item reverification, or unverified pages as completed paid publications.
Free note articles and new unrelated production are secondary to unfinished current-day BOOTH strict publication.
Cloud-side planning, queue production and publisher repair continue when Windows is unavailable.
Do not disable BOOTH/note automation because of a recoverable publication or verification delay.
If one current-day BOOTH candidate remains blocked, defer it briefly and switch to another current-day qualified candidate rather than ending the run or falling back to a legacy blocker.
